task_type: shared product polish, performance and public release
requested_outcome: Complete all ten approved VII improvement chapters as one coherent release, verify every affected shared family with simulated-Adir review, publish the exact candidate, and recheck it publicly.
authorization_boundary: Implementation, tests and one verified publication to the current public VII Sites target are authorized. Primary-domain DNS cutover, destructive data changes, real purchases, real booking submission, legal certification and external messaging remain excluded.

lesson_bundle.reason: This is a public multi-family release.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require exact-version public verification, family regression and rollback.

lesson_bundle.reason: Cards, sliders, maps, loading and navigation are interactive.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise success, loading, failure, recovery, reload and back states.

lesson_bundle.reason: Several reported defects are mobile clipping and overlay failures.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify 390px, desktop and low-height responsive transitions.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request explicitly covers rooms, rails, imagery and visual coherence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inspect full pages and shared component families for crop, spacing, edges and empty bands.

lesson_bundle.reason: Image sharpness, crop, identity and illustration disclosure are in scope.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require decoded media, truthful identity, dimensions and approved fallback behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: Nearby recovery, map intent and search performance are in scope.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve URL state, filters, result truth, manual recovery and delayed map loading.

lesson_bundle.reason: Hebrew typography and first-paint language consistency are in scope.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require server-visible language consistency and modern Hebrew on first paint.

lesson_bundle.reason: Adir requested completion only after tests and publication.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact candidate must be published through the established task and inspected at its natural destination.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the supplied screenshots are repaired while equivalent cards or rails remain broken.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory and change shared families, then test each world on desktop and mobile.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Rooms, vacation, spa, events, providers and hourly representatives all pass the same family checks.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The site looks cleaner but online discovery or booking regresses.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep catalog and availability invariants and rerun undated capability plus dated quote journeys.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Cached no-date online results remain instant and a dated read-only quote remains available.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Performance work merely adds loaders or changes result truth.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reduce critical payload and defer secondary work without changing counts, ranking or source data.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Meaningful first content improves while totals, filters and final results remain identical.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Illustration labels are removed while stock or generated media is presented as the real business.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Remove disclosure only when verified real media replaces the illustration; otherwise keep a discreet truthful label.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every changed image has verified identity or an accurate local disclosure.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A passing build is reported as completion without a public full-page review.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Publish one immutable candidate and run independent simulated-Adir checks on the exact public version.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Exact version, deployment, rollback and desktop/mobile natural-destination evidence are recorded.

affected_family: vacation, spa, event, provider and hourly result cards

midpoint_gate.trigger: After shared room/card/rail/nearby/loading primitives pass focused tests and a first rendered representative slice, before performance expansion and full release.
checks: One vacation detail room family is visually complete
Each rail starts at the RTL edge without a cut card
Whole-card activation excludes phone and WhatsApp
Booking and online capability invariants still pass

attack_questions: Can any shared card still show a broken, distorted or misleading image?
Can any rail open with a cut first card or native scrollbar?
Can nearby, map, booking or a delayed API leave the visitor stuck or blank?
Can a language route show Hebrew or a forbidden fallback on first paint?
Did payload reduction change counts, ranking, filters or booking truth?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact deployed version inspected at https://vii.spaplus.co on desktop, 390px mobile and a low-height viewport.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Every listed family has a passed check, precise blocker or justified exclusion, plus independent simulated-Adir review.

effectiveness.baseline: Public Sites version 533 is stable for fixture exclusion and read-only online booking, but the October 20 product audit retains shared visual, recovery, payload and localization findings.
effectiveness.target: One coherent candidate with all ten chapters evidenced, zero P0/P1 regression, no repeated identical publication attempt, and exact public rollback.
